name: centroid_null_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE geom IS NOT NULL AND centroid_lat IS NULL

name: geom_not_null_geometry_null_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE geometry IS NOT NULL AND geom IS NULL

name: outside_polygon_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE geom IS NOT NULL AND centroid_lat IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_Contains(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(centroid_lng, centroid_lat),4326))

name: pointonsurface_gt_1m_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE geom IS NOT NULL AND centroid_lat IS NOT NULL AND ST_DistanceSphere(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(centroid_lng, centroid_lat),4326), ST_PointOnSurface(geom)) > 1.0

name: centroid_in_neighbour_parcel_count
sql: WITH drifted AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(centroid_lng, centroid_lat), 4326) AS c FROM parcels WHERE geom IS NOT NULL AND centroid_lat IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_Contains(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(centroid_lng, centroid_lat), 4326))) SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS c FROM drifted d CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p2.id FROM parcels p2 WHERE ST_Contains(p2.geom, d.c) AND p2.id <> d.id LIMIT 1) hit

name: centroid_algorithm_drift_gt_1m_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcels WHERE geom IS NOT NULL AND centroid_lat IS NOT NULL AND ST_DistanceSphere(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(centroid_lng, centroid_lat),4326), ST_Centroid(geom)) > 1.0
